instructions: This is an additive catalog of direct peer configs, not an operator-preparer request. Copy one configs entry, fill the required null placeholders, and save that object alone as fresh UTF-8 JSON without BOM. Follow REFRESH-USAGE.md. Public TLS templates below are choices to complete, not live endpoints or credentials. Numbers are finite example ceilings, not capacity guarantees.

placeholders.specs: Use an actual successful shared-symbol SPECS.json array. Use the same exact route in provider_feed.entries[0].specs, registrar.slots[0].specs and reader.routes[0]. The reader.specs may add justified conjuncts, up to eight total, while retaining every route feature.
placeholders.host: Select the actual numeric IPv4 address. Feed and registrar listener addresses belong to their respective operators; learned mathematical-provider addresses must pass both registrar and reader egress policies.
placeholders.server_name: Select the actual lower-case TLS certificate name, or null only when the selected literal-IP certificate is appropriate. Registrar endpoint_scopes.tls_names must contain the approved mathematical-provider name, not the feed or registrar name.
placeholders.tls_files: Select existing approved certificate/key files and calculate their lowercase SHA-256 values. Never copy private key material into this catalog.
placeholders.ca_file_and_ca_sha256: The paired nulls intentionally select system CA trust for an explicit known feed/directory. To use an approved private CA for a direct contact, supply both its local path and hash. Learned mathematical contacts cannot carry a private CA.
placeholders.port: 443 is the public TLS example. Choose permitted reachable ports and update the corresponding egress public_ports lists. A local loopback setup needs the explicit alternative described in REFRESH-USAGE.md.

shared_symbol_names_example_meaning: Std.HashMap. Save this array alone only when that exact name belongs to your approved selected context or historical name directory; it is a name, not an invented portable symbol ID.
